rows.statement: Cowork lets users start a task and check in on it later to get finished deliverables

sides.text: With Claude Cowork, you can start a task at your desk, check in on it from your phone, and get a polished deck, document, or spreadsheet for review.
Some sessions may fail to start or disconnect mid-task; affected sessions can be retried.

rows.statement: Claude claims top-tier results in reasoning and image processing

sides.text: Performance: Top-tier results in reasoning, coding, multilingual tasks, long-context handling, honesty, and image processing.
We have seen the best results with Gemini models for visual reasoning, achieving SOTA (beating Claude Fable) on the strongest grounded reasoning benchmark we have found (Databricks OfficeQA).
